mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees at the Verona Area High School with partly cloudy skies under a full moon. The International Space Station passes overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has several items on the agenda for the Plan Commission meeting on November 4th, including development proposals for Ardent Glen and the Milky Way site. Additionally, property tax bills are expected in the mail by December 15th.

Today you can head to Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, tomorrow features trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company and Lake Lou-ee. Later in the week, look forward to Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving behavior while transporting students.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with today's flavor of the day, Pumpkin Pecan. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
